user.description: Enter the YQT Smart account details for the watches you want to expose.

reauth_confirm.description: Update the password for this YQT Smart account.

set_dnd_schedule.name: Set Do Not Disturb schedule
set_dnd_schedule.description: Write the watch's Do Not Disturb schedule. Traced from APK analysis only and not yet confirmed against a live device.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: Up to 4 schedule windows, each as "START-END:DAYS", e.g. "22:00-07:00:mon,tue,wed,thu,fri". Omit entirely to clear/disable the schedule.
